Commentary.Commentary: The subcontinental side will be the happier of the two sides. They will fancy their chances to chase this target down. The Proteas do possess a bowling line-up capable of defending this score. We should be in for an exciting chase. Join us in a while for it.

Pakistan on the other hand, were excellent with the ball. Hasan Ali was the pick of their bowlers, bagging 3 wickets. The slow bowlers were also very effective with the ball. Junaid Khan and Mohammad Amir were excellent in the death overs with their yorkers and did not give a lot away.

So, South Africa have crawled their way to 219. It is all thanks to David Miller who constructed his innings well and helped them reach a decent total. This was only the second time he faced over a hundred balls in an ODI. He finished with an unbeaten 75. He along with Chris Morris and Kagiso Rabada have given the Saffas something to bowl at. Their top order failed to build partnerships. Their highest partnership of 48 was for the eighth wicket between Miller and Rabada.
FOUR! No he cannot! Short and around off, Miller stays in his crease and slaps it through extra cover for a boundary. That is a good end to the innings by Miller. SOUTH AFRICA FINISH WITH 219/8!
Slower and on the shorter side, Miller gloves his pull towards short fine leg. He does not take the single again. Hasan Ali has bowled nicely. Can he finish well?
Fuller on off, Miller drives it towards mid off from his crease. This has been a good over for Pakistan.
Shorter in length, Miller pulls it through mid-wicket. The ball goes hard to Shadab who dives but fumbles. Two runs taken.
Hurls across a good length delivery on the stumps, Miller looks to pull it through but is beaten all ends up.
Slants it on a good length on middle and leg, Miller pulls it to deep square leg. Refuses the single.
Hasan Ali to bowl the final over of the innings.
Morne Morkel is the penultimate man in.

OUT! What a catch, Hasan Ali! Fuller and on the stumps, Rabada looks to go big but fails to connect well. Hasan Ali goes after it from long off and gets under it to take a superb catch. That was really well taken. Rabada has to go back to the hut after a good cameo. Replays show Miller ensured that he was on strike as they did not cross.
FOUR! Edged! Good length around off, Rabada goes for the pull but gets a top edge over the head of the keeper for a boundary.
Angles it on the stumps, Miller clips it through square leg for a single.
Low full ball around off, Rabada plays a stylish slap down to long on for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Miller mistimes his slap over covers for a single. Signaled two for the over. We won't have any high bouncers coming this over.
WIDE! Shorter in length just around off, Miller cannot ramp it up. The umpire signals it a wide for height.

SIX! It's Killer Miller Time! Full and outside off, Miller has now had enough, he gets under this one and clobbers it over long off for a maximum. Junaid did not miss his yorker by much there. 200 up for SA, enough for them?

Yorker on middle, Rabada turns it through wide mid on for a couple of runs. 11 RUNS FROM THE OVER, FOR THE FIRST TIME THIS INNINGS. Amir has bowled out for 10-0-50-0! One thinks he has bowled far too well to have those figures.
Rabada clips it through mid-wicket and Shadab Khan running in, fumbles while picking it up and concedes a couple of runs.
Very full and on the pads, Miller clips it towards short fine leg. Hasan Ali tries to have a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Had he hit, that would have been close.
Yorker again, back to their best. Rabada digs it out towards the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Finally a boundary, first one after the 39th over. Short and angling on the body, Rabada gets under it and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Interesting that Amir went for the shorter one despite getting the yorkers in regularly.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Miller controls his hook down to fine leg for a single.
Low full toss on the stumps, Miller chips it on the bounce to mid off for a quick single. Miller has done well to ensure that they play out the overs.
Slower short ball outside off, Rabada mistimes his pull down to long on for a single.
Fuller and on the stumps, Rabada clips it through wide mid on for a couple of runs. Malik was the fielder there who fumbled while attempting to throw at first.
Good length outside off, punched towards covers from his crease.
Fuller in line of the stumps, Miller clips it in the air towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good length outside off, Rabada plays a nice jab through mid-wicket but only for a single.
Fuller outside off, Rabada drives it through covers for a single.
Full again on the stumps, Miller backs away a touch and drives it towards mid off for a single.
Another fast yorker on the stumps, Miller digs it out towards fine leg for a couple of runs. That was more off an inside edge.
Rabada punches it through covers for a single.
Good length on middle, Miller taps it towards covers for a quick single.
Fuller outside off, Rabada drives it off the outside edge down to third man for a single.
Slower yorker on the stumps, Rabada turns it towards mid-wicket for a single. That was brilliantly bowled.
Good length around off, Radaba looks to play a stylish pull but mistimes it towards mid on. Miller has a word with Rabada after that shot.
Another yorker on the stumps, Kagiso defends it from his crease. Pakistan are bowling well.
Low full toss on the stumps, Miller clips it to long on for a single.
Rabada has a change of bat.
Fuller around off, Rabada chips it down the ground through mid on for a single. He has not timed his shots here but luckily has got them in the gaps. He signals for a change of bat.
Shorter outside off, Miller mistimes his pull to wide long on for a single.
Low full toss on the stumps, Rabada turns it towards mid on from his crease.
Fuller around off, Miller digs it out towards long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, Rabada drives it towards mid off for a single.
Slants it on the stumps, Miller looks to clip but is hit on his pads. The ball goes down to third man. The umpire signals it a leg bye.
Shorter in length outside off, Miller looks to ramp it over the keeper but misses.
Rabada drives it through covers for a single.

NOT OUT! Oh my, my, Junaid Khan! Yorker on the stumps, Radaba looks to dig it out. He gets it towards the off side. Junaid appeals but to no avail. He convinces his skipper for a review. Replays are not what he would have hoped for. The ball never hit the pad and unfortunately, that can't be out lbw as per the rules for now. A review wasted down the drain. In the meanwhile, a single was taken.
Rabada is not given out lbw and Khan does not like it. Pakistan review.
Just short of the crease! Fuller in length, angling on the stumps, Rabada chips it towards mid on. The ball drops short of Malik.
10th ODI fifty for David Miller.
Fuller outside off, Miller drives it towards mid off for a single. That is a fifty for David Miller. He has done all the hard work here. Can he make it a big one?
Kagiso Rabada is the new man in. He can hit the ball well.

OUT! Junaid Khan gets his man at last! Bowls a cutter on middle, Morris looks to go big but gets a top edge down to long on. Hasan Ali makes no mistake and the 47-run stand is broken. A vital wicket for Pakistan.
Low full toss outside off, Miller clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Hurls in a fuller one on the stumps, Morris drives it through mid on for a single. South Africa have been unable to hit the boundaries here.
Too full again outside off, Morris can only dig it out towards mid off for a single.
Another yorker on the stumps, Morris digs it out towards the off side.
Spears in a low full toss on the stumps, angling in, Morris jams it out.
Fuller around off, Morris drives it towards mid off.
Shorter in length, Morris pulls it over mid-wicket for a couple.
Does not carry! Low and full on the stumps, Morris looks to go over mid off but mistimes it. The ball goes on the bounce to mid off.
Good length on middle, Morris taps it towards covers for a single. This is already the best stand for SA in the game, Pakistan need to break this partnership.
Low full toss around off, Miller clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Angles it around off, Miller taps it towards covers and sends back Morris who was looking for a single.
BEATEN! Hurls it outside off, Miller looks to drive but fails to connect.
Yorker around off, Morris digs it out towards mid off for a single. Good ball, that.

BOWLED OFF A NO BALL! Junaid bowls one fast and on the stumps, Morris plays all-round it and has his stumps disturbed. But that is not a dismissal as Khan has overstepped and it is no ball. Oh dear, Pakistan cannot believe it. Khan has his head down. Sarfraz has his hands on his mouth. To make matters worse, Morris will now face a Free Hit!
Woah! Starts off with a yorker on off, Morris digs it out.
Junaid Khan returns for a bowl.
Powerplay 3 signaled. Five fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle.

NOT OUT! Top review, Miller! Amir bowls a yorker on middle and leg, tailing in, Miller looks to keep it out but seems to have missed it. The players go up in an appeal and the umpire rules it in favour of the bowler. Miller goes for the review straightaway. Has he hit that one? Replays confirm there was no bat there. Waiting for the Ball Tracker now. It shows that the ball was missing the leg stump and hence Miller survives. That is a top review by South Africa.
A brilliant yorker from Amir, Miller is given out lbw. He reviews it though.
Drops it short outside off, Morris backs away and slaps it off the outer half to third man for a single.
Doles it on a length outside off, Morris punches it towards covers.
Goes round the wicket and angles it on the stumps on a shorter length. Morris picks it and ducks under it.
Sprays it wide outside off, Morris drives it on the up through covers for a couple as Zaman mops up in the deep.
Bowls it full and on the stumps, Morris digs it out. He straightaway signals for a fresh pair of gloves.
In the air but safe! Loops it around off, Morris gets across and flicks it in the air through mid on for a single.
Miller this time sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Shorter outside off, cut through point for a single.
Leg spinner around off, Morris comes forward and defends it.
FOUR! In the gap! Fires it around off, Morris sits low and just sweeps it hard in front of square on the leg side for a boundary. That was hit hard. 150 up for SA. Boundary after a long time.
Drops it around middle and leg, turned through square leg for a single.
Change of ends for Shadab Khan.
Fuller outside off, a cutter maybe, Morris drives it through covers for a brace.
Hurls it outside off on a fuller length, Miller looks to clip but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Extra bounce! Slants it on a good length, the ball kicks off the surface and bounces more on Morris. He does well to control it and dab it towards third man for a single.
Digs it short outside off, Miller walks across but does well to control the pull through square leg for a single.
Good length ball coming in from outside off, Miller stays back and defends it towards the off side.
Angles it on off, on a fuller length, Miller defends it from his crease.
Another bowling change, Mohammad Amir called back on.
Shorter outside off, placed towards point by Morris.
Fires it on off, keeps a tad low, David does well to turn it through mid on for a single.
Quicker on the stumps, Miller looks to work it through but is hit on his pads.
Floats it wide outside off, Miller sits low to sweep but fails to connect.
Drops it short on middle, Miller punches it towards covers.
Floats it around off, driven through mid off for a single.
A mini-conference between the senior players for Pakistan. Imad Wasim handed the ball now.
Floats it outside off, Morris drives it through covers for a single.
Too full on the stumps, Miller drives it through mid off for a single.
Bowls it around off, Morris comes forward and opens his face of the bat and gets it towards covers for a single.
Lands it outside off, Morris flashes it towards backward point from his crease.
Shorter around off, Miller pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Sarfraz says it's okay to him in their local language.
Looped on the stumps, driven through mid off for a single.
Back of a length outside off, guided through point for a single.
In the air but safe! Hurls it outside off on a length, Miller drives it through cover-point for a single.
Good length outside off, Miller defends it towards covers from his crease.
Amir is warming up. We could see Pakistan going for the glory here.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers for a brace by Miller.
Back of a length on middle, Morris tucks it through backward square leg for a single.
Yorker around off, Morris digs it out from his crease. That was nicely bowled.
DRINKS. This has been a superb performance from the Pakistanis so far. They will now aim to continue the good work and keep South Africa below 250. That will be a par score on this wicket.
Shorter outside leg, Miller turns it towards short fine leg.
Gets across a touch and clips it through mid on for a single.
Loops it outside off, Morris looks to go through the off side but fails to read the spin there.
Floats it outside off, spins away, Morris reads it and defends it well.
Shorter on off, spins in, Miller works it towards square leg for a single off his back foot.
Googly outside leg, Miller sits low to sweep but is hit on his body.
Fuller outside off, Miller digs it out over the head of the bowler for a single as the mid off fielder cuts it off to his left.
Fuller in length, angling on the stumps, Morris turns it through backward square leg for a single.
Shorter in length but outside off, Morris gets out of the way.
Length outside off, Morris drives it towards point from his crease.
Lands it outside off, Morris drives it towards covers from his crease.
Fuller outside off, Miller shuffles to the off side and works it towards wide mid on for a single.
Shorter around off, Morris late cuts it towards short third man. The fielder goes to his right and stops it.
Lands it outside off, Morris drives it to covers where there is another good stop.
Morris gets in line and defends it.
Shorter outside off, Morris cuts it towards point.
Full toss outside off, Miller drives it to long off for a single.
Morris drives it through covers for a single to get off the mark.
There is a square leg now in place.
Short again but wide again, Miller sways out of the way. First maiden of the game and Hasan Ali has put Pakistan right on top.
Lands it outside off, Miller angles it towards backward point where Shadab dives and stops the ball. Another superb effort.
Full again just around off, Miller drives it crisply towards mid off where Wasim stops the ball.
Shorter but wide outside off, Miller lets it go through happily.
Fuller outside off, Miller drives it towards covers where Hafeez dives and stops it. Can't believe this is the same side which played India a few days back. They are fielding like tigers.
ALMOST! Fuller in length just around off, Miller defends it back to the bowler. Ali gets the ball in his hands and scores a direct hit at the striker's end. The intensity is up for them.
Hasan Ali is on a hat-trick here.
Turns it through the leg side for a single.
Floats it around off, Morris sits down to sweep but gets a top edge towards the vacant square leg region for a single.
Shorter outside off, Miller cuts it to cover-point for a single. There was a fumble there, should have cut it off well.
Googly around off, Miller looks to work it through the leg side but is beaten all ends up. David loses balance but thankfully is inside his crease.
Darts it on the pads, Miller looks to clip but is hit on his pads.
Miller turns it towards the leg side off his crease.
With the right-handed batsman out in the middle. Shadab Khan comes on.
Looks like we jinxed SA, Chris Morris has to come out to bat.

OUT! GONE FIRST BALL! Hasan Ali angles it on the stumps, on a length, Parnell looks to defend but plays down the wrong line. The ball just moves away at the last moment and clatters into the stumps. Another golden duck for a South African and Pakistan are right on top. Hasan Ali will be on a hat-trick when he bowls his next over.
Wayne Parnell has come out to bat. Above Chris Morris, so maybe they are saving him for the slog overs. Two slips in place.

OUT! Duminy falls! Goes round the wicket, bowls it full outside off, Duminy goes for the drive but can only get an outside edge. This time the ball flies to the right of Babar Azam at first slip. He takes the catch and that is a big wicket for Pakistan. Hasan Ali has his second. You don't often see JP grind his team out of trouble and that has happened again. South Africa in a huge spot of bother now.
Lands it outside off, Miller drives it nicely through covers for a single.
Amir is warming up...
A tad short around off, Duminy controls his pull through square leg for a single.
Good length around off, Miller gets across and works it towards mid on for a single.
There is a slip in place yet Duminy opens the face of the bat and guides this wide of the fielder for a single.
There looks to be an issue with the ball. Miller has given it a hammering. A slip in place for Duminy, by the way.

SIX! Tonked! Hafeez gives it a bit of air, Miller slinks down the wicket and clobbers it over long on for a maximum. There was a fielder in the deep but it went way over him. Hafeez ends with figures of 10-0-51-1! Decent workout for him.
Silly point in place.
Watches Miller dance down and shortens his length, Miller can only defend it back down the wicket.
Fuller around off, Duminy comes down and turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on middle and leg, Duminy stands tall and turns it towards mid on from his crease.
Shorter outside off, punches it through covers for a single.
Miller comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Fuller outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Fuller in length on off, Miller comes forward and defends it towards covers.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Miller looks to pull but is beaten by the bounce on it.
Miller gets across and pushes it off the inner half towards mid on.
A tad short outside off, Miller angles it towards point.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Miller rides the bounce and defends it.
Duminy comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Flatter on the stumps, Duminy keeps it out.
Lands it around off, Miller turns it towards mid-wicket for a quick single. There is a bit of confusion but no harm done.
SIX! Stupendous shot! Fuller on off and middle, Miller comes down the wicket and just dumps it over long on for a maximum. This is a superb strike.
Punches this one towards covers for a single.
Floats it on off, Duminy comes forward and defends it.
BOUNCER! THAT WAS QUICK! Short ball on the stumps, Miller first goes to pull but then bails out of it and the keeper jumps and collects it.
Short on the stumps, Duminy pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Full ball outside off, Miller drives it to the right off mid off for a run.
Full ball on the stumps, Miller drives it straight back to the bowler.
A tad short, Miller goes for the pull but misses it and gets struck on the thigh pad.
Length ball angling across the off stump, Duminy defends it off the back foot.
Tosses it up, Duminy drives it to the right of covers and sets off. Miller is not intrested and sends him back. The fielder hits the stumps at the striker's end but the batsman is safe.
Bowled on off, Miller pushes it to covers for a run.
Tosses it up on off stump, Miller drives it to covers.
Bowls it on the middle stump, Miller defends it off the front foot.
Drags it short, Miller goes for the flick but the man at short leg is alert and fields the ball.
Flights it on the stumps, Duminy comes down the track and drives it to long off for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Bowled on the pads, Duminy flicks it on the leg side for a run.

Back of a length ball on the stumps, Miller plays it off the back foot to mid-wicket and sets off for a run. Malik who picks the ball and goes for a direct hit but misses it. Would have been close had he hit.
Full ball outside off, Duminy drives it to mid off for a run. He is off the mark.
JP Duminy strides out to the middle.

OUT! The bowling change works and Faf departs. Hasan Ali bowls it on a length outside off, Faf looks to force it through the off side but gets an inside edge onto the stumps. Fourth wicket for Pakistan and it's the in form Faf du Plessis. Brilliant captaincy, Sarfraz.
A tad fuller on off, Faf drives it straight to covers.
Hasan Ali comes on for a bowl.
Flatter on the stumps, Faf pushes it down to long on for a run.

FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Hafeez bowls it on the stumps, Faf goes down on one knee and paddles it through the vacant fine leg area. Ahmed Shehzad (sub) runs to his right and dives but cannot stop the boundary. These two are ticking along well.
Drags his length back a little, du Plessis punches it to mid-wicket.
Tosses it outside off, Faf looks to drive it but gets an edge to backward point.
Flatter ball on off, Miller punches it off the back foot for through cover for a single.
Bowled on middle, Faf flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on the pads of the batsman, Faf flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
Miller dances down the wicket, Wasim drags back his length. Miller adjusts and pushes it down to long on for a run.
Fires it on middle, Miller drives it back to the bowler.
Tosses it up, Faf pushes it down the ground to long on for a run.
Bowled on the pads, Miller tucks it on the leg side for a run.
Fired onto the pads of du Plessis, who goes to drive it but gets it off the inner edge of the bat to mid wicket for a run.
Tosses it on middle, Miller defends off the front foot. Seven runs from the over, good one for South Africa.
Miller runs down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Flighted ball on middle, du Plessis comes down the track and flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Tosses it on off stump, Miller pushes it to the right of covers for a run. The fielder was slow to react.
Bowls it on middle, Faf flicks it to square leg for a run.
Du Plessis paddle sweeps the ball on the stumps down to fine leg for a couple.
Drags his length back a little, du Plessis tucks it on the leg side for a run
Fires it in on the stumps, du Plessis defends it off the front foot.
Quicker ball on middle, Faf defends it off the front foot.
Bowled on the stumps, Miller comes down the track and drives it to long on for a run.
Flatter on off, Faf punches to covers for a run.
Fires it in on the stump, Faf drives it to covers.
Fuller on off, Miller comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Flatter on middle, turned towards mid-wicket where Ali fumbles and allows a single.
Flatter outside off, hit towards mid on who cuts it off going to his left.
Shorter outside off, punched towards covers where the fielder makes a superb stop. It is Shadab again.
Nudges it through short fine leg for a single.
Fuller on middle, Miller turns it towards mid-wicket where Shadab dives to his right and stops the ball. This is top work by Pakistan, for a change.
Faf gets in line to defend but pushes it towards covers from his crease.
Flatter on middle, du Plessis turns it towards short fine leg. Miller wants a single but is sent back in time. There is a wild shy at the bowler's end which is not on target.
Darts it on the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Leading edge! Lands it on middle and leg, Miller looks to clip it but gets a leading edge towards covers.
Flatter on the stumps, Miller defends it back down the wicket.
Drops it short outside off, punched through covers for a single.
DRINKS! This is a superb period of play for Pakistan. After a nervy start, they have taken three big wickets and are right on top here.

BIG APPEAL! Hafeez bowls it quicker, Miller goes for a flick but misses it and is hit on his pad. They all appeal but the umpire is not interested as the ball maybe sliding down the leg side. The spinners are causing problems here for the Proteas.
Drives the full ball back to the bowler. Hafeez gets a hand to it but parries it towards extra cover. No run taken though.
Floats it on the stumps, Miller defends it off the front foot.
Flights it on the stumps, Faf drives it down to long on for a run.
Bowls it on the leg stump, Miller flicks it to fine leg for a run.
Short leg comes into place.
Tosses it on off, Miller defends it off the front foot.
Flatter on the stumps, Faf pushes it off the front foot.
Drives the ball to covers for a run.
David Miller is the new man in. South Africa under pressure here.

OUT! BIG WICKET! AB de Villiers is heading back to the hut. What a wicket for Pakistan. Imad, you beauty. Tosses it outside off, de Villiers goes for the expansive drive, gets an outside edge straight into the hands of Hafeez at backward point. This is AB's first ever golden duck against Pakistan. South Africa are in big trouble here.
Drags it short, Faf tucks it to the leg side for a run.
Flights it up on off, Faf drives it to mid on.
Flatter on the stumps, du Plessis defends it on the front foot.
AB de Villiers is the next man in.

OUT! Hafeez strikes in time! Pakistan had missed the review earlier but this time they have their man. Hafeez bowls it a little quicker on the stumps, de Kock goes down on one knee and goes for the sweep but misses it and the ball strikes him on his pad. They all appeal and the umpire gives him out.
Bowls it on the stumps, de Kock plays it to mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! That would relase the pressure. Hafeez tosses it up, de Kock comes down the track and lofts it over mid-wicekt for a boundary.
Drags it short, du Plessis punces it down to long on for a run.
Tosses it up, Faf drives it to covers.
Drops it short again outside off, de Kock once again misses out as he finds the fielder at covers.
Shorter outside off, de Kock cuts it towards point from his crease. A good period of play for Pakistan here.
de Kock comes down but can only push it back to the bowler.
Shorter outside off, cut past point for a single.
Fuller on middle, turns it back down the wicket, the bowler goes to his right and stops it.
Flatter outside off, du Plessis punches it towards covers.

BIG APPEAL! Full ball on the stumps, de Kock comes forward and tries to flick it but misses it and is struck on the pads. They all go up but the umpire gives it not out. Hafeez wants it to be reviewed but Sarfraz is not confident and they opt not to. Replays show that the ball was hitting the stumps. They have missed an opportunity here and they may live to regret it.
Slower on the stumps, Faf turns it on the leg side for a run.
Comes down the track, de Kock flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
De Kock comes down the track, Hafeez bowls it on the leg side. De Kock flicks it to deep square leg where Fakhar Zaman misfields and concedes two.
Flatter on the stumps, de Kock defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it up on off, de Kock pushes it to covers.
Drives the ball on off stump, down to mid off for a quick single. The mid off fielder was slow to react to the ball.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fires the ball on off stump, Faf pushes it to covers where Ahmed Shehzad (sub) fumbles and concedes a run.
Tosses it up on the pads, Faf flicks it to short fine leg.
Slower on the pads this time, de Kock tickles it down to the left of short fine leg for a run.
Fires it full outside off, de Kock drives it to mid off.
Powerplay 2 signaled. Four fielders are now allowed outside the circle for the next thirty overs.
Flighted ball on off, de Kock drives it down to long off for a run.
Tosses it up on the stumps, Faf drives it down to long on for a run.
Flicks the ball on middle to the mid-wicket fielder.
Floated on the pads, de Kock flicks it to the right of mid on for a triple.
Flights on middle, Faf  punches it to long on for a run. That stopped on the batsman.
Tosses it up, Faf drives it to the cover fielder.
Mohammad Hafeez comes on to bowl.
Quicker ball outside off, de Kock goes for the cut but misses it.
Angles it into the pads, du Plessis flicks it to the leg side for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fires it on the stumps, Faf pushes it off the front foot.
Faf du Plessis comes out to bat.

OUT! PLUMB! What a wicket for Pakistan. The in-form Amla departs. Imad angles it in with the arm around off, Amla goes on the back foot and tries to work it on the leg side but misses and is struck on the pads. They all go up and the umpire gives it out. Doesn't take the review as it looked plumb.
Flatter ball on the pads, de Kock pushes it to square leg for a run.
Imad Wasim comes on for a bowl.
Length ball angling away, Amla tries to guide it down to third man but gets an under edge which rolls to slip.
Bowled on the pads, Amla flicks it on the leg side for a couple.
FOUR! WHAT TIMING! Length ball on the pads, Amla just flicks it through square leg and the ball races away to the fence. Amla is looking good here.
Bowls it on a length angling into the pads, de Kock flicks it to the left of mid on for a run.
Lands it on a length on middle and off, Amla flicks it to fine leg for a run.
Length ball on the stumps, de Kock tries to drive it on the up but gets an inside edge to the right of fine leg for a single.
FOUR! NICE SHOT! Amir bowls it short on the stumps. Amla shuffles across and pulls it over square leg for a boundary. Ends the over with a boundary.
Length ball angling across the batsman, Amla pushes it to the cover fielder.
Slower ball on the stumps, Amla taps it on the off side.
Back of a length ball angling into the pads, de Kock flicks it to short fine leg for a single.
Lands it on a length on middle, de Kock pushes it straight back to the bowler.
Length ball on off, de Kock defends it off the back foot.

Fuller but slower in pace, de Kock clips it wide of mid on. Hasan Ali gives it a chase as the ball slows down near the ropes. The fielder eventually gets to it and keeps the ball in play. Three runs taken.
Shortish outside off, de Kock lets it go through with a duck.
Slower in pace, on a fuller length, just around off, de Kock turns it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Shorter outside off, de Kock angles it wide of the point fielder. Shadab gives it a chase and slides near the fence to keep the ball in play. Good work and just the two runs for the batsman.
Good length on off, de Kock stands his crease and defends it to covers.
Turns it towards the on side from his crease.
Full toss on the stumps, de Kock flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run. De Kock must have felt he missed out over there.
Tad fuller on off, Amla pushes it wide of mid off for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
WIDE! Bouncer down the leg side. Amla goes for the pull but misses it. They all go for an appeal but the umpire signals a wide.
Fuller ball outside off, Amla lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Short ball on the stumps, Amla pushes it on to the off side.
Shortish ball outside off, de Kock guides it down to third man for a run.
WIDE! Bowls a bouncer, which bounces way above the batsman's head. Amla ducks under it. Sarfraz is unable to collect it and the batsmen run through for a bye.
Back of a length, de Kock plays it to the point region.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Back of a length ball on the stumps, de Kock defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! LUCKY EDGE! Length ball outside off, de Kock slashes at it and gets an outside edge past the second slip for a boundary. Pakistan are bowling some tight lines here.
BIG APPEAL! Bowls it on leg stump, de Kock goes for a flick but misses it and is struck on the pads. They all appeal but the umpire is not interested as it was going down leg.
Length ball which jags in a little, de Kock tries to defend it but gets an inside edge on to the box and rolls on to the off side. That is not a good feeling for anyone, let alone a batsman.
Bowled on the pads, Amla flicks it behind square leg for a couple.
Length ball on the stumps, de Kock drives it to mid on and sets off for a run. Shoaib Malik has a shy at the non striker's end but misses the stumps. Had he hit de Kock was a goner.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

ALMOST! Length ball which jags into the batsman, de Kock tries to defend it off the front foot but gets an inside edge which hits his pads and just goes over the stumps to the keeper. Pakistan almost get their first wicket.
Length ball, angling into the batsman. De Kock pushes it down to mid on.
Bowls it on the pads, de Kock tries to leave it for a wide but the ball brushes his thigh pad. Sarfaraz dives to his right and collects it.
Length on the stumps, Amla drives it on the up to cover.
Bowls it wide outside off, Amla tries to cut it but gets beaten.
Lands it on a length on middle, Amla pushes it to mid on.
A tad fuller on the stumps, Amla opens the face of the bat and guides it through covers for a couple.
Length ball on the pads, Amla tucks it on the leg side for no runs.
Length ball outside off, de Kock looks to cut it but gets an outside edge down to third man for a run.
Junaid Khan to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Length ball on off, Amla looks to defend it off the back foot but gets an inside edge onto the pads and the ball rolls onto the off side.
Length outside off, Amla lets the ball go through to the keeper.

Back of a length delivery outside off, de Kock dabs it through cover-point. Hasan Ali gets across from third man, dives and stops it from going to the boundary. The batsmen run three. First runs of the day for South Africa with the bat.
Full ball on the stumps, de Kock defends it covering the line of the ball.
Back of a length ball on off, de Kock defends it off the back foot.
Lands it on a length outside off, de Kock lets the ball go through to the keeper.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, de Kock goes for the flick but misses it and the umpire signals a wide.
Game time! The two openers for South Africa are Hashim Amla and Quinton de Kock. Pakistan begin with Mohammad Amir. He has a couple of slips in place. Here we go...
The players are out in the middle for their respective national anthems.

Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed says that they wanted to bat first but they can't change the toss. Informs about the two team changes, Junaid Khan and Fakhar Zaman coming in for Wahab Riaz and Ahmed Shehzad. Adds that they had a meeting yesterday and the morale of the team is very high. Hopes that they do well today.

South Africa skipper, AB de Villiers informs that they are going have a bat. Adds that they batted well in the last game. Thinks the wicket has worn a little. He opines it won't turn a lot and would remain the same. He further adds that they were good in 80 percent of the game against Sri Lanka and if they could take that up to a 100 percent then they would be a real good team. He informs they are playing an unchanged team.
TOSS - South Africa win the toss and opt to bat.

PITCH REPORT- Shaun Pollock reckons that the wicket is a touch dry and on the slower side. Expects the spinners to do well since there is no moisture on the wicket. He opines that the team winning the toss should bat first.

Pakistan were thumped by India in their opening fixture and will be hoping for a better show today. It is a must-win game for them. They had a forgetful time with both bat and ball. Sarfraz Ahmed will know that if they don't raise their game it could be curtains for many of them. Stay tuned for the toss and further updates.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the match between South Africa and Pakistan at Edgbaston. The Proteas had a convincing win in the first game against Sri Lanka and skipper AB de Villiers will hope that his men can repeat that performance today. The only area of concern for them could be the new-ball bowling as even Sri Lanka exposed that in the previous game.
